items.key: lesson|_tz3210_5rta89nj|TS0601|window pusher routed as wall dimmer
items.symptom: MOES ZC-LP01 sliding window pusher would pair as a wall dimmer
items.cause: stale local mfs hint (confidence 0.08, TS0601_dim1) listed the manufacturer on wall_dimmer_tuya, whose productId includes TS0601
items.check: compose: couple is on curtain_motor, absent from wall_dimmer_tuya; dpMappings lock DP102=state DP104=position DP4=battery
items.fix: move exact couple to curtain_motor, sacred DP map from Z2M/ZHC, onMapDeviceClass so already-paired devices keep the same id
items.evidence: Z2M ZC-LP01; ZHC moes.ts; forum 156967 post 101

items.key: lesson|cover|DP2 vs DP3|target position overwrites actual
items.symptom: curtain tile stuck on last requested position; hand moves not shown
items.cause: DP2 is target/set; actual position is often DP3 (or another report DP). Updating the tile from the target DP after the actual DP has reported hides the real position.
items.check: CoverPositionSource.accept(2, x) is false after accept(3, y)
items.fix: wire CoverPositionSource into UnifiedCoverBase as well as wifi_cover

items.symptom: device request; ZHA exposes unused temp/humidity/lux and PIR stays off without a Tuya handshake
items.cause: fingerprint missing from our motion drivers; advertised clusters are not proof of hardware
items.check: pir_sensor_2 lists the exact couple; capabilities stay alarm_motion + battery (no invented temp/humidity)
items.fix: add exact couple to pir_sensor_2 (IAS Zone already handled)
items.evidence: forum 162420 post 1; ZHA issue 5709; Z2M TS020C page as family reference

items.symptom: after re-pair or driver move, Flows still point at the old device id
items.cause: Homey binds flow cards to a device UUID; a new pairing gets a new id
items.check: prefer onMapDeviceClass so the id is kept; if re-pair is required, changelog/digest/settings mention Flow Converter
items.fix: in-place map first; settings preview + optional Flow Converter; do not request homey:manager:api on this device app
items.evidence: forum 154906 (late4marshmellow Flow Converter, capability mapping since 1.2.0)

items.symptom: Tuya Cloud tile showed 163 C for a 16.3 C electric radiator
items.cause: Tuya often ships temperatures (and some timers) with a decimal scale; treating the raw integer as Celsius overshoots by 10
items.check: implausible ambient temperature (e.g. > 80 C) should apply the documented scale, same family as humidity x10
items.fix: recorded for existing scale helpers; do not invent a couple from this Wi-Fi-only report

items.symptom: MOES ZT-SY-EU 2-gang scene remotes occasionally fire two single-press events about 1s apart, often first press after a Homey restart
items.cause: developer logs showed two real Zigbee frames; Johan TS0044 work already covers transport-keyed dedup. A long same-action debounce can help but must not swallow a real double-press report.
items.check: existing button dedup tests; do not treat two typed 'double' events as bounce
items.fix: recorded; TS0044/scene dedup remains the in-tree fix path (other session). User suggestion of 1.5s same-button single debounce is a candidate only.

items.key: lesson|_tz3000_wkai4ga5|ts0044|duplicate trigger per press; missing long press|two cluster-6 frames per press (commandon/off/toggle + tuya 0xfd); transport-keyed dedup and double listener registration after re-init/migration
items.symptom: duplicate trigger per press; missing long press
items.cause: two cluster-6 frames per press (commandOn/Off/Toggle + Tuya 0xFD); transport-keyed dedup and double listener registration after re-init/migration
items.check: assert PressActionDedup drops mixed transports for the same endpoint+action; installOnce on zclNode
items.fix: dedup per endpoint+action in a short window; bind listeners once per zclNode; forward release only when sent (MOES long press about 5s)
items.evidence: JohanBendz/com.tuya.zigbee issues #864 and #793, commits around 2024-10-12 (v0.2.71-v0.2.73). Reporters RBouroubi, roxart, SunBeech. Forum 26439/5542 read-only lesson (v0.3.4 regression after revamp, gone after Homey restart post-migration).
